text: Contrast policing with shaping, and give the rule of thumb.
choices: Policing drops or re-marks excess; shaping buffers and releases it smoothly. Shape what you send, police what you receive
Shaping is only for inbound traffic
explanation: Shaping outbound to about 95% of the carrier's contracted rate moves the queue from the carrier's device — where you have no visibility or control — into your own, where your policy decides what gets dropped. It is one of the highest-value configurations in branch networking.
